name: Green Zionism
summary: Green Zionism is a strand of Zionism that treats care for Israel's land, water and climate as part of the Zionist project. It draws on A. D. Gordon's idea that national renewal comes through labor on the soil and a bond with nature, and today it is carried mainly by Aytzim and the Green Zionist Alliance, which campaign inside the World Zionist Organization and the JNF. It supports Israel as a Jewish state while pushing strong climate and conservation policy and a liberal-progressive social outlook.
scope: The modern organized strand represented by the Green Zionist Alliance and Aytzim (since 2001), rooted in Gordon's eco-Zionism. Social and economic answers outside the environment and Zionism are mostly inferred from Aytzim's progressive coalition stances, so many are low confidence. It excludes Israeli green parties as electoral parties and non-Zionist Jewish environmentalism.

public-ownership.rationale: Aytzim wants a larger public share of Israeli gas profits and greener public bodies like the JNF, but no stance on nationalizing utilities is documented; adherents are split.

cut-welfare.rationale: Aytzim opposed proposed SNAP cuts, showing the movement defends welfare programs.

worker-ownership.rationale: Gordon's labor ideal and Zionist cooperatives (kibbutz) lean this way, but modern Green Zionism documents no stance on worker ownership.

legalize-drugs.rationale: No documented stance; progressive adherents may favor it but Jewish-traditional ones less so.

state-harmful.rationale: Green Zionism wants to strengthen Israel as a Jewish state and works through state bodies like the JNF, so the state is not seen as harmful.

decide-locally.rationale: Aytzim promotes local action (EcoJews, community gardens) but also centralized Congress and state policy; no stance documented.

traditional-family.rationale: Ecological Judaism draws on tradition, but the progressive wing is liberal on family; adherents are split.

more-religion-public.rationale: Aytzim brands itself Ecological Judaism and works with clergy, but also supports a pluralist Israel; no clear position on public religion.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Aytzim publicly supports Black Lives Matter and environmental justice, showing support for correcting racial injustice.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Gordon framed Zionism as national cultural revival through return to the soil, and Green Zionism keeps that national-renewal aim.

gradual-change.rationale: Aytzim works through institutions like Congress and the JNF, but also backs drastic climate measures; split.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: The movement seeks environmental cooperation with Israel's neighbors, but nothing addresses UN power; adherents are split given Israel's UN relations.

limit-growth.rationale: Aytzim backs a Green New Deal and sustainability, yet frames environmental work as improving Israel rather than degrowth; split.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Aytzim won Congress climate resolutions in 2015, supports the Green New Deal and climate strikes, and ends fossil extraction on JNF land.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Aytzim promotes solar and efficiency tech but also warns of fossil technology; no general stance.

revolution-justified.rationale: Gordon rejected Marxist class struggle and avoided party politics; Green Zionism works through Congress voting.

one-party-rule.rationale: Aytzim operates as a competing slate in democratic Congress elections and criticizes illiberal measures like the Nation-State Bill.

democracy-best.rationale: Green Zionists win seats and resolutions through Congress voting and defend liberal democracy against the Nation-State Bill.

workers-councils.rationale: Gordon avoided party and class structures; no support for councils documented.

political-violence-never.rationale: Gordon was a pacifistic moralist, but Zionism has accepted defensive force; adherents split.

war-builds-character.rationale: Gordon framed national renewal through labor and moral cosmos, not war; an environmental-peace movement rejects glorifying war.

separate-church-state.rationale: Ecological Judaism and clergy partners push religious ethics, while progressive Zionists often favor separation; split.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Aytzim cites Leviticus and shmita for ethics but advocates secular Congress policy; no scriptural law agenda.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Aytzim favors public regulation and public bodies; privatizing courts and defense is inconsistent.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Gordon explicitly rejected Marxist class struggle in favor of national, organic unity.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Gordon stressed solidarity and social equality but not equal outcomes as a goal; nothing settles it.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Aytzim supports environmental justice, but Zionism claims Jewish indigeneity to the land, so adherents hold mixed readings.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Aytzim backs racial and environmental justice, but Zionists generally reject a colonial label for their own state, so adherents split.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Gordon stressed duty to labor and nation, but modern progressive adherents emphasize rights.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Gordon held humans and nature form a cosmic whole and that Jews had profaned nature; Green Zionism takes nature's protection as a core value.

limit-population.rationale: Environmentalism sometimes ties to population limits, but no Green Zionist source does, and Jewish tradition values large families.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Gordon criticized urban separation from nature, but modern Green Zionists work within Israel's industrial economy.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Not an issue the movement has taken up; liberal and security-minded adherents differ.

restore-past-order.rationale: Gordon wanted renewal, not restoration; the movement is forward-looking on climate.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The movement is pragmatic in pursuing resolutions and JNF seats, but it is also driven by an ideology of nature and Zionism; split.

direct-action.rationale: Aytzim supports climate youth strikes and coalition action but works mainly through Congress and institutions.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Gordon wanted Jewish farmers on the land, not foraging; no one in the movement advocates it.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Gordon rejected Marxist analysis of class exploitation.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Gordon rejected Marxist class struggle and party dictatorship; the movement is democratic.

collective-farming.rationale: Zionist kibbutz tradition favors collective farming, but Gordon also valued individual personal labor; split.

taxation-theft.rationale: Aytzim seeks public shares of gas profits and public funding of green projects.

state-as-business.rationale: Green Zionism treats the state as steward of land and environment, not a business.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Aytzim supports Black Lives Matter and anti-racism; racial genetic hierarchy is incompatible with the platform.

total-state.rationale: Gordon preferred organic voluntary bonds over mechanical state control and the movement is democratic-liberal.

national-rebirth.rationale: Gordon's religion of labor sought a radical rebirth of the Jewish people through return to the land, which Green Zionism inherits.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Environmental cooperation with neighbors points against expansion; not directly documented.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Rule by personal oaths is foreign to a democratic congress-based movement.

bound-labor.rationale: Gordon's ideal was free self-chosen labor on the land.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: The sources show no epistemology; Aytzim relies on scientific environmental evidence while engaging religious frames.

single-common-good.rationale: Ecological Judaism points to a shared stewardship good, yet the movement works through competing slates; split.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Green Zionism is defined as a branch of Zionism that supports Israel as a Jewish state.

revive-national-language.rationale: Hebrew revival was part of the Zionist national project Gordon belonged to; not specifically documented for Green Zionism.

rule-by-example.rationale: Gordon stressed personal example, but modern adherents rely on laws and resolutions; split.

national-self-determination.rationale: Zionism is Jewish national self-determination in Israel, and Green Zionism is a branch of it.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Aytzim mixes scientific and religious ecology; split.

class-collaboration.rationale: Gordon rejected class struggle, favoring national solidarity across labor and capital.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Gordon's cultural revival values heritage; destroying it is not part of Zionism.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Aytzim backs Black Lives Matter and opposes discriminatory laws like the Nation-State Bill.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Aytzim opposes fossil-fuel extraction and fracking on JNF land.

elite-replacement.rationale: A conspiracy theory incompatible with the progressive coalition work of Aytzim.

national-mission.rationale: Gordon hoped the Jewish renewal would also benefit humanity, but spreading a form of government is not part of this.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Tal noted resolutions go unimplemented, but no general stance on elites.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Eugenic measures conflict with the movement's progressive humanist stance.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Aytzim demands active environmental regulation and public action.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Zionism rejects the colonial characterization and Gordon saw return as native replanting in the homeland.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Ecological Judaism values religious teaching, while progressive adherents often favor secular schools; split.

population-transfer.rationale: The movement stresses cooperation with neighbors and opposes discriminatory laws.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Gordon was a moral thinker, but Zionism has accepted force in defense; adherents do not hold an absolute nonaggression principle.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Gordon's organic cosmic harmony contrasts with competition as engine.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Opposing illiberal laws pulls one way, while Israeli practice of banning extremist lists pulls another; split.

vanguard-party.rationale: Gordon rejected party politics and class struggle.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Aytzim wins Congress seats by election and shows no interest in sortition.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Not a documented issue; environmental progressives may accept it, free-market Zionists would not.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Gordon lived ascetically but there is no documented rule.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Zionism stresses national sovereignty, while green internationalism favors pooling; the sources do not settle it.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: No Green Zionist support for abolishing rental housing.

people-in-arms.rationale: Early Zionist self-defense ideas existed, but not in this strand.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Gordon held that return to the soil and nature restores moral and spiritual health.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: The ingathering of Jews is a Zionist aim, but reunifying a split nation by borders is not what the sources discuss.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Religious adherents may favor restriction while liberal ones oppose; the sources are silent.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Law of Return follows descent, yet the movement opposes ethnic exclusivity; split.

religious-exemptions.rationale: A religiously pluralist movement may favor exemptions, while progressive adherents may not; split.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Aytzim has no development finance platform; split between justice-minded and fiscal views.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Gordon tied political rebirth to a transformed labor and land relationship, but the statement concerns colonial independence, which is out of scope here.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Contradicts the movement's democratic character and its resistance to growth-first policy.

central-bank-independence.rationale: No monetary policy is discussed in the sources.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Gordon tied the Jewish homeland to the land, but the movement takes no documented position on territorial compromise; split.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Banning fracking on JNF land and demanding a public share of gas profits treat land as serving public and ecological ends.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Aytzim opposes fracking and fossil extraction and backs the water protection and climate resolutions before irreversible harm.

collective-defense.rationale: Zionism relies on alliances but the sources show no stance on treaty commitments.

character-from-environment.rationale: Gordon said labor and nature form character, a nurture view, but no one in the movement says innate nature is minor; split.

leader-cult.rationale: Gordon avoided leadership and honor; movement is democratic.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family law is not covered; progressive adherents may favor it but evidence is missing.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Zionism unites Jews, but the question is about political unity across borders of kin peoples, which is not an explicit Zionist or green aim.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Zionism rejects minority autonomy within others' states in favor of a state of its own.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Zionism holds that Jews should build a homeland rather than rely on diaspora emancipation, which a branch of Zionism inherits.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Aytzim opposed the Nation-State Bill, which signals support for constraint on majority rule.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Aytzim favors binding environmental standards in public bodies and cross-border cooperation.

moral-incentives.rationale: Gordon's religion of labor stressed moral duty over material incentive.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Gordon and the movement reject revolutionary violence.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary reform does not appear in this strand's concerns.

minority-veto.rationale: Congress works by majority votes, as with the 487 to 19 climate resolution, so individual vetoes are not part of its practice.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Jewish dietary tradition permits use with kindness, but a vegetarian wing exists; split.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Gordon wanted equal labor, not aristocratic duty, but giving to the less fortunate is a Jewish value; split.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Aytzim is a political slate in the World Zionist Congress.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Gordon rejected class analysis, so this Gramscian claim finds no echo.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Gordon stressed self-labor, but Zionism has relied heavily on diaspora funding via the JNF, so adherents split.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Zionism rejects this; Jews see themselves as indigenous returnees.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Gordon rejected Marxism, but a comparison with fascism is not a topic the sources address.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Religious law constrains divorce in Israel; Ecological Judaism sources are silent, so adherents split.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Congress delegates are elected and sources do not describe recall.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Gordon and the JNF's national land tradition hold land as national property used by those who work it.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: National-land tradition, but no documented stance.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Gordon criticized treating nature as commodity; Aytzim promotes sustainability.

corporate-influence.rationale: Aytzim criticizes fossil industry interests and wants public share of gas profits.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Aytzim is itself funded from abroad and works in Israel, which cuts against restrictions, but Israeli supporters of such laws exist; split.

job-guarantee.rationale: Green New Deal includes it, but Aytzim does not itemize; split.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Aytzim backs civil protest by youth strikes, but a general denial of duty to obey is not part of this.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: A conspiracy claim of this kind is incompatible with the movement's anti-racist coalition work and its opposition to discriminatory legislation.

local-production.rationale: Aytzim promotes community gardens and local sustainability projects through EcoJews and Jewcology.

informal-organisation.rationale: Green Zionists organize as a formal slate and registered nonprofit, working inside Congress structures.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Zionism values sovereignty, yet Aytzim backs global climate norms; split.

religious-nation.rationale: The Jewish nation is partly religious, but Gordon and modern Green Zionists define it by national revival; mixed, leaning against a purely religious definition.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Tribute systems have no place in Green Zionism.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Gordon was an ascetic for whom personal labor mattered, but nothing in the sources opposes private belongings.

defeat-communism.rationale: Gordon rejected Marxism but Green Zionism has no Cold War stance in the sources.

religion-illusion.rationale: Aytzim brands itself Ecological Judaism and engages clergy, so religion is treated as a source of meaning, not an illusion.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Aytzim criticizes fossil capitalism, but nothing in the sources judges capitalism's historic role.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Gordon grounded Jewish presence in the land in return to the natural soil from which Jews were uprooted, a historical tie that Zionism treats as foundational.

holocaust-denial.rationale: As a Zionist movement, Green Zionism rejects Holocaust denial; the Jewish state arose partly from that history.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Aytzim's progressive coalition makes this implausible.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Green Zionists contest elections in Congress as an opposition slate and would not endorse suppression.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Not an Islamic movement and its concerns are different.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: The movement works within democratic Zionist institutions.

assisted-dying.rationale: Jewish ethics diverge from liberal views here; split.

alienated-labor.rationale: Gordon argued that Diaspora Jews were cut off from creative labor and nature, a classic alienation theme.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Contradicts the movement's pluralist alignment and cooperation with neighbors.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Ecological Judaism cites divine commandments for stewardship, yet Zionism is a national movement; split.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Zionism treats a defended state as essential.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Aytzim defends welfare like SNAP, but it has no stance on IMF conditions.

reification.rationale: Gordon criticized treating nature as a commodity but did not use this framework.

racial-franchise.rationale: Contradicts the movement's anti-racism and opposition to the Nation-State Bill.

online-participation.rationale: Aytzim organizes online via Jewcology, but no stance on online decision-making is stated.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Jewish tradition resists intermarriage but progressive adherents do not support laws; split.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Ecological Judaism reads tradition for modern conditions, for example linking shmita to emission plans.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Not an element of Green Zionism.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: The strand favors cooperation with neighbors, but no position on consociational governance is documented.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Aytzim opposed SNAP cuts, favoring government programs.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Early Zionist youth movements existed, but this strand has no such program.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Israel's nuclear policy is ambiguous and unmentioned in the sources.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Gordon's religion of labor held that people should live by their own work on the land.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Gordon saw return as replanting the people in its native soil from which it had been uprooted.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Zionism aims to gather the Jewish people in Israel, though Green Zionism also engages diaspora communities.

culture-before-state.rationale: Gordon stressed spiritual renewal first, yet Green Zionism works through state bodies; split.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Gordon rejected class power, but Green Zionists do not argue about defining socialism.

municipal-property.rationale: Gordon's agricultural communities hold land communally, but the sources give no municipal-ownership program.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Health regulation is outside this strand.

online-anonymity.rationale: Aytzim organizes online through Jewcology, but nothing speaks to anonymity rules.

person-over-state.rationale: Gordon's organic nation conflicts with pure individualism; split.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Gordon treated labor and nature as spiritual, and Aytzim brands itself Ecological Judaism.

gm-crops.rationale: Aytzim promotes sustainable farming but does not address genetic engineering.

dense-cities.rationale: Aytzim backs bike lanes, but also rural reconnection; split.

racial-pride.rationale: Jewish national pride is central to Zionism, but the statement is about race and the movement supports racial-justice causes; split.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Hebrew revival mattered, but not defining.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: The movement shows no sign of such a claim and its coalition work cuts against conspiracy framing.

future-generations.rationale: Ecological Judaism draws on Leviticus fruit-tree laws and shmita, stressing stewardship across generations.

arms-reduction.rationale: The movement stresses environmental cooperation with neighbors, but Zionist security concerns also weigh; split.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Climate justice might lead there, but the movement's documented platform is about Israel's environment, so adherents are undecided.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Gordon avoided party politics and violence; movement works within state bodies.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Gordon's communes and kibbutzim were experimental, yet the movement states no stance.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Aytzim values nature intrinsically, which conflicts with pricing, but also uses economic arguments for conservation; split.

sacred-nation.rationale: Gordon viewed the nation as an organic spiritual whole renewed by labor.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Israel's nuclear posture is a taboo subject, and no Green Zionist source speaks to it.

workers-own-party.rationale: Gordon avoided party politics and Labor Zionism had its own party; split.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Aytzim backs drastic climate action but also supports liberal causes; split.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Hebrew is the national language of Israel, but the movement has no stance on language requirements.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Gordon's eco-Zionism makes a spiritual bond between the people and the land, renewed through labor on the soil, the movement's root idea.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Gordon's religion of labor treats labour on the soil as the source of national renewal and human worth, though he did not state a technical theory of value.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Gordon's Labor Zionism joins national renewal to the dignity of the working people, and the strand descends from it.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Aytzim opposed proposed SNAP cuts, showing the movement defends welfare programs. (Carried over from cut-welfare, "Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

missingStatements.text: Environmental protection of a country's land and water is part of what it means to love and build the homeland.
missingStatements.rationale: Gordon's return to nature and Aytzim's Congress water and climate resolutions tie homeland-building to land protection.

missingStatements.text: Public land held in trust for a nation should be managed by sustainability standards, such as no fossil-fuel extraction.
missingStatements.rationale: Aytzim opposes fracking and fossil extraction on JNF land and pushed JNF environmental policy.

notes: Green Zionism is thinly documented: Wikipedia treats it as a short stub, so most non-environmental answers are inferred. Its Israeli-Palestinian positions beyond environmental cooperation with neighbors are not set out in the sources.
